desc: Arisaka Magnifier Mounts come in two styles. The MML (Magnifier Mount Low) positions a magnifier at a 0.9" optic centerline over the rail, which is useful on rifles with a large drop from the top of the receiver rail, such as the AK family, Galil ACE, SAN Swiss and B&T APC series. The MMH (Magnifier Mount High) positions a magnifier at 1.54" to 2.26" optic centerline height and uses a pivot system that lets the magnifier rotate outwards 90 or 180 degrees. The 180 degree position places the magnifier below the plane of view, so it does not obstruct the field of view from the non-dominant eye. Each version is made for a specific magnifier footprint and height, so check the product title for the version that fits your setup.
